2. James and John together have ?24, and James has ?8 more than John. How many dollars has each?

Let x stand for the number of dollars John has; then x + 8 is the number of dollars James has; and x + (x + 8) is the number of dollars they both have.

But 24 is the number of dollars they both have.

∴ x + (x + 8) = 24.

Removing the parenthesis, x + x + 8 = 24.
